structure.conductivity_scope: Effective single-layer regression from stacked-specimen heat-flow-meter tests; not a directly measured single-sheet k or validated pressure law
structure.construction_scope: Detailed yarn, weave/knit, finish and ply construction not established by the retained tables
structure.geometry_scope: Nominal uncompressed material-group geometry fixed with temperature; thermal expansion, pressure and moisture changes are not modeled
structure.identity_scope: Historical conditioned material group; not a current branded SKU or raw fiber law
structure.reported_uncertainty: Section 6.4 method-level relative combined standard / expanded (coverage factor 2): conductivity 5.8% / 11.7%; specific heat 27% / 54%; density 5% / 10%. Not per-coefficient covariance, sample SD, hard bounds, or a computed prediction interval
structure.rights: Attributed factual numerical observations and equations; no source images or pages redistributed
structure.source_conflict_areal_mass: none identified at the adopted Table 2 effective-property scope
structure.source_conflict_specific_heat: Withheld: main Table 4 has +9e-8*T^3; Appendix A Table 4A text has -9e-8*T^3; Figure 8A text has +0.0028*T rather than the tables' -0.0028*T. Appendix Table 5A also reports experimental Cp(50C)=1.62 versus calculated 1.32 J/(g K). No preferred equation or correction inferred.
structure.source_tables: NISTIR 7282 June 2005: Tables 1 and 2 p.4; Tables 3 and 4 p.14; methods sections 3 and 4; uncertainty section 6.4
structure.specific_heat_scope: PerkinElmer DSC7, three specimens, 0..100 C fitted range; conditioned at least six months; pan-contact/swelling limitations retained
structure.validation_scope: Source transcription and numerical-model checks only; no held-out garment, cold-weather, PPE, flammability or machine-process qualification

areal_density.method: Product of Table 2 mean thickness and reported bulk density. Derived effective areal mass, not a separately measured mass/area or mean of paired products; covariance unavailable

conditions.scope: Conditioned material group, not one identical coupon for every test; batch identifier unreported

bulk_density.method: Table 2 reported material-group bulk density; not constituent solid-fiber density

conditions.scope: Conditioned material group, not one identical coupon for every test; batch identifier unreported

reported_cp_at_20_c.method: Table 4 rounded Cp at 20 C; retained even when the competing polynomial is withheld

conditions.scope: Conditioned material group, not one identical coupon for every test; batch identifier unreported

reported_k_at_20_c.method: Table 3 rounded k at 20 C; retained separately from the equation, not a measured knot

conditions.scope: Conditioned material group, not one identical coupon for every test; batch identifier unreported

thickness.method: Table 2 mean micrometer thickness, avoiding visible compression; pressure dependence not characterized

conditions.scope: Conditioned material group, not one identical coupon for every test; batch identifier unreported

conductivity.method: Main Table 3 Celsius linear fit; reported k20 rounding is retained separately; fitted single-layer values are estimates

conditions.uncertainty_scope: R-squared is not uncertainty; coefficient covariance not supplied and measurement uncertainty is not propagated by this model

nist7282.note: Lawson, Walton, Bryner and Amon. Estimates of Thermal Properties for Fire Fighters' Protective Clothing Materials. NISTIR 7282, June 2005. Tables 1–4 and sections 3, 4, 6.4. Main tables visually checked; Appendix A conflict leads from extracted text, so disputed curves are withheld pending facsimile/erratum verification.
